label: evaluation
design: Cohorts from tick 0 (workshop-1, library sharing within a cohort, teaching off). Every researcher has the same per-lifetime pool of 48 search credits; proposals, development tests, component tests and submissions each cost one credit. Primary comparison: first-improvement (v0.4 reference policy) vs beam, each with preserved and reset cross-cohort access. Separate language-capability comparison: beam vs beam-nocomponents, both preserved. Policies differ from the first decision, so physical parity is checked on the initial state; access parity (preserved vs reset, same policy) is checked at the first boundary.
selection_rule: freeze: lowest validation score among admitted or superseded workflows (components excluded); ties by creation tick then id; the frozen record includes the workflow's dependency closure by hash
